title: gate_research_in refuses an empty feature request
intent: Pin the entry gate's refusal: a request that fails the FeatureRequest schema never reaches an LLM node and routes to graceful_failure.

artifact.reason: gate_research_in refused the request: featureRequest is not a usable request
artifact.detail: The run stopped at gate_research_in: gate_research_in refused the request: featureRequest is not a usable request.

expected.notes: Exactly one pinned response, and it is the failure writer: if any research effect were invoked this case would fail, which is the assertion — the gate refuses BEFORE the model is called.
